title: 第23章 千万不要前往第24章 来世再做你妹妹
content_zh:
第23章千万不要前往一股旺盛的生机在萧沉体内流转，他那微若游丝的气息，竟也在逐渐平稳起来。
“太好了，萧沉没死！”
白念冰惊喜地喊道，使得白家众人尽皆一愣，脑子有些转不过来。
在真元耗尽的情况下，硬生生接了辛度一掌，还将辛度都给毒死了，众人都以为他必死无疑，竟然，还能活下来？
“这家伙，还能创造多少奇迹？”
白家长老们上前，确认了萧沉的确在恢复，不由得发出一声感慨。
“没死？”
凌远图目光僵硬在原地，像是怀疑自己的耳朵出了问题。
青甲军团溃败，辛度被毒杀，他城主府的苦海九重强者尽皆被灭，结果，萧沉没死，他还活着？
这绝对是凌远图无法接受的结局。
“城主大人，你枉费心机了。”
白清风大笑，搞了这么大的阵仗，结果却是一场空！
“不，我不相信！”
凌远图大吼，一口老血喷涌而出，他踉跄倒退，脸上满是惨笑。
“今日参与围剿的冷家和周家之人，一个也不放过！”
白清风此刻正是得意时，今后，远风城，白家独尊！
白家之人俱都无比兴奋，尤其是年轻一代的子弟，更是嗷嗷乱叫，被萧沉先前的无敌风采所感染，大杀向前。
数位白家长老第一时间找上了冷家之主，同时狂风暴雨般轰击，纵然冷家之主心有悔意，不断求饶，白家的长老们也没有放过他！
本来城主府的强者，再加上冷家和周家的长老，面对白家不见得完全没有一战之力，可他们阵脚已乱，只想着逃命，已无力回天！
白清风也没有丝毫保留，运尽全力，朝着凌远图的方向拍打而去，不杀凌远图，后患无穷！

嘭！
凌远图仓促间轰出一掌，被白清风强横的掌力震得吐血后退，他的目光并未看向白清风，而是死死盯着躺在不远处的萧沉。
轰！
他的身躯直扑萧沉而去，像是完全无视了白清风，事到如今，哪怕付出性命的代价，他也要萧沉死！
“嗤嗤！”
他人还没到萧沉身前，一柄利剑便刺透了他的胸膛，那是白念松击杀而出的一剑，凌远图连躲都没躲，任由利剑从他身体穿透而过。
最终，凌远图倒在了萧沉面前，眼神里写满了不甘和愤恨，可他的杀子之仇，却永远也报不了了。
众人感慨不已，远风城，大局已定！
“不要杀我们，我们是被逼的啊！”
有周家长老被迫入绝境，两位白家的长老盯上了他，同时出手，轰得他五脏六腑仿佛都碎掉了。
“先前跟着凌远图的时候，不是很威风吗？现在才说自己是被逼的，太晚了！”
很快，白家不仅击杀了来犯的周家和冷家之人，还直接杀入了两家的府院，掠夺他们的功法神通以及珍藏的神兵、丹药！
这对两大家族而言，绝对是毁灭性的打击！
白清风亲自带人前往城主府，没有大肆掠夺，却将凌远图的尸体丢在地上，威慑城主府之人。
最后，凌远图的家眷乖乖将奇珍异宝奉上，祈求保命。
“劳烦夫人写一份信，派人送往皇城，信的内容，该怎么写，不需要我多说了吧？”
白清风对着凌远图的夫人问道。
“明白，我夫君作恶多端，天理不容，他的死，与人无尤。”
凌远图的夫人战战兢兢地说道。
content_en:
Chapter 23 Never Go There was a strong vitality flowing in Xiao Chen's body, and his aura that was as light as a gossamer was gradually becoming more stable.
"Great, Xiao Shen is dead!"
Bai Nianbing shouted in surprise, which made everyone in the Bai family stunned and couldn't think straight.
When his true energy was exhausted, he forcefully took Xindu's palm and poisoned Xindu to death. Everyone thought that he would definitely die, but he could still survive?
"How many more miracles can this guy create?"
The elders of the Bai family stepped forward and confirmed that Xiao Chen was indeed recovering, and couldn't help but sigh.
"Not dead?"
Ling Yuantu's eyes froze in place, as if he suspected there was something wrong with his ears.
The Qingjia Army was defeated, Xindu was poisoned, and all the ninth-level warriors in his city lord's palace were destroyed. As a result, Xiao Shensuo died. Is he still alive?
This is definitely an ending that Ling Yuantu cannot accept.
"Lord City Lord, your efforts have been in vain."
Bai Qingfeng laughed, such a big battle turned out to be in vain!
"No, I don't believe it!"
Ling Yuantu roared, and a mouthful of old blood spurted out. He staggered back, with a sad smile on his face.
"No one from the Leng family and Zhou family will be spared who participated in today's encirclement and suppression!"
Bai Qingfeng is at the moment when he is proud. From now on, the Bai family will dominate Far Feng City!
Everyone in the Bai family was extremely excited, especially the younger generation. They were howling and screaming. Infected by Xiao Chen's previous invincible demeanor, they started to fight forward.
Several elders of the Bai family immediately approached the head of the Leng family and bombarded him like a storm. Even though the head of the Leng family felt regretful and kept begging for mercy, the elders of the Bai family did not let him go!
Originally, the strong men of the City Lord's Mansion, plus the elders of the Leng family and the Zhou family, might not be able to fight against the Bai family, but their positions were in chaos and they just wanted to escape, unable to save their lives!
Bai Qingfeng didn't hold back at all, and used all his strength to swoop away in the direction of Ling Yuantu. If he didn't kill Ling Yuantu, there would be endless troubles!
Bang!
Ling Yuantu hurriedly struck out with a palm, but was shaken by Bai Qingfeng's powerful palm force and vomited blood and retreated. His eyes did not look at Bai Qingfeng, but stared at Xiao Chen who was lying not far away.
boom!
His body rushed towards Xiao Chen, as if he had completely ignored Bai Qingfeng. At this point, even if he paid the price with his life, he wanted Xiao Chen to die!
"Chichi!"
Before he could reach Xiao Chen, a sharp sword pierced his chest. It was Bai Niansong's killing sword. Ling Yuantu didn't even dodge, letting the sharp sword penetrate through his body.
In the end, Ling Yuantu fell in front of Xiao Chen, his eyes filled with unwillingness and resentment, but his revenge for killing his son could never be avenged.
Everyone was filled with emotion, far away from Fengcheng, the overall situation has been decided!
"Don't kill us, we are forced!"
An elder of the Zhou family was forced into a desperate situation. Two elders of the Bai family targeted him and attacked him at the same time, so much that his internal organs seemed to be shattered.
"Isn't it impressive when I followed Ling Yuantu earlier? It's too late to say that I was forced to do so now!"
Soon, the Bai family not only killed the invading Zhou family and Leng family, but also directly entered the two houses and plundered their martial arts, magical powers, and treasured magic weapons and elixirs!
This is absolutely a devastating blow to the two families!
Bai Qingfeng personally led people to the City Lord's Mansion. He did not plunder it wantonly, but threw Ling Yuantu's body on the ground to intimidate the people in the City Lord's Mansion.
In the end, Ling Yuantu's family members obediently presented the rare treasures and prayed for their lives.
"Madam, could you please write a letter and send someone to the imperial city? I don't need to say more about the content of the letter, right?"
Bai Qingfeng asked Ling Yuantu's wife.
"Understand, my husband has done many evil things, which is not allowed by heaven. His death is no different than that of others."
Ling Yuantu's wife said tremblingly.
